title: Terminal B Drop
description: Retrieve a hidden encryption device from an airport dead-drop locker and tap its contents before surveillance picks up the signal.

hints: The first half of the code is equal to the number of birds in the china cabinet. Count carefully.
The second half of the code is the number of words in the sentence found within a particular framed photo.
The sentence you are looking for begins like this: It does not really matter...

config.instruction: A network scan sweeps the terminal area. Do you hold position to map the traces, or cut the connection and clear out?
The transfer window is closing. Choose what to keep.
